verdict.rationale: Washington ESD runs account-based portals (eServices, EAMS via SecureAccess Washington) that hold employer and claimant records, so data export and portability is a fair question. However, the evidence pack documents no capability to export account data in open formats. The cited pages cover filing reports, amending them via a PDF form, and logging in, none of which is a data export, and the transactional portal sits behind an authentication wall.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
